Market.marketDescription: Main market with the largest selection of assets and yield options

MarketBasicInfo.netWorthTooltip: The total value of your supplied assets minus borrowed assets in this market.
MarketBasicInfo.netApyTooltip: The weighted average of your supply and borrow APYs, reflecting your overall earning or cost rate across all positions.

MarketSummary.tooltipTotalMarketSize: The total value of all assets currently deposited into this market. It represents the sum of all supplied collateral and liquidity across every reserve.
MarketSummary.tooltipTotalAvailable: The total liquidity available to be borrowed right now. This is the difference between total supplied assets and currently borrowed assets.
MarketSummary.tooltipCurrentApy: The weighted average annualised percentage yield earned by suppliers across all reserves in this market, based on current utilisation.
MarketSummary.tooltipUtilizationRate: The percentage of the total supplied liquidity that is currently being borrowed. Higher utilisation drives borrow rates up and supply rates up via the interest rate model.
